name: Nitron
rootCause: On May 16th, Demex's lending market Nitron was exploited, resulting in a loss of $950,559 in user funds. According to Demex's post-incident analysis, the root cause of the exploit was a donation-based oracle manipulation attack targeting the deprecated dGLP vault.
